steps.js: (async()=>{const vis=e=>e.getClientRects().length>0&&getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden';const nz=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').trim();const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body&&c!==document.documentElement){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}return document.scrollingElement};const root=document.querySelector("body")||document.body;const el=[...root.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>vis(e)&&nz(e.textContent).startsWith("Compras, vendas, v\u00ednculos, saldos e documentos fiscais continuam com a mesma l\u00f3gica.")).sort((a,b)=>a.textContent.length-b.textContent.length)[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-360);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=c.scrollTop,t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/700),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTop=y0+dy*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
